items.title: 1.3.1 Solution of Quadratic Equations by Completing the Square (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum quadratic equation ko "completing the square" (square poora karne) ke tareeqe se hal karenge, chahe us ke roots complex hi kyun na hon. Pichli classes mein aap ne yeh tareeqa real roots wali equations ke liye parha tha. Pichle sabaq mein aap ne polynomials ko linear factors mein torna seekha. Aaj dono cheezein mil jayengi: pehle roots nikaalenge, phir unhi roots se factors banayenge.

Kitab kehti hai: jaise hum pichli classes mein parh chuke hain, completing the square quadratic equations hal karne ka ek taqatwar aur bataraqeeb (systematic) tareeqa hai. Is mein quadratic equation \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) ko perfect square trinomial (aisa teen terms wala expression jo kisi bracket ka poora square ho) ki shakal mein likha jata hai, phir dono sides ka square root le kar hal kiya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par tab kaam aata hai jab quadratic aasani se factor na ho. Completing the square se hum har quadratic equation hal kar sakte hain, chahe us ke roots irrational hon ya complex.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Idea kahan se aaya? Is formula se: \((z - h)^{2} = z^{2} - 2hz + h^{2}\). Agar humare paas sirf \(z^{2} - 2hz\) ho, to us mein \(h^{2}\) jor dene se square "poora" ho jata hai. Jaise koi tasveer ka aakhri tukra (puzzle piece) kam ho aur hum woh tukra laga dein. Jorne wala number hamesha (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) hota hai.
Tareeqa, qadam ba qadam:
1. \(z^{2}\) ka coefficient 1 banayein (poori equation ko \(a\) se divide karein).
2. Constant term ko right side le jayein.
3. Dono sides par (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) jorein.
4. Left side ko \((z - h)^{2}\) likhein aur \(\pm\) ke saath square root lein.
5. Agar right side negative ho to \(\sqrt{-k} = i\sqrt{k}\) use karein; roots complex honge.
Khud sochiye: \(z^{2} + 10z\) ko poora square banane ke liye kya jorna hoga? (Jawab: \(5^{2} = 25\), kyun ke \(z^{2} + 10z + 25 = (z + 5)^{2}\).)

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem: Solve the equation \(2z^{2} - 12z + 50 = 0\) by completing square method and hence express it as a product of its linear factors.
steps:
Given: \(2z^{2} - 12z + 50 = 0\).
To find: completing the square se is ke roots, aur phir \(2z^{2} - 12z + 50\) ko linear factors ke product ki shakal mein.
Method: sawal do kaam maang raha hai. Pehla kaam: roots. Is ke liye pehle \(z^{2}\) ka coefficient 1 banayenge, phir dono sides par (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) jor kar perfect square banayenge, aur square root lenge. Doosra kaam ("hence" ka matlab hai "isi se"): mile hue roots ko corollary \(P(z) = a(z - z_{1})(z - z_{2})\) mein rakh kar factors banayenge.

Step 1: Dono sides ko 2 se divide karein
\[z^{2} - 6z + 25 = 0\]
Kyun: completing the square tab sab se aasan hai jab \(z^{2}\) ka coefficient 1 ho, kyun ke humara pattern \(z^{2} - 2hz + h^{2}\) mein \(z^{2}\) akela hai. Right side \(0 \div 2 = 0\) hi rahi. Dhyan dein: har term ko divide karna hai: \(12 \div 2 = 6\) aur \(50 \div 2 = 25\).

Step 2: Constant ko right side le jayein aur middle term ko naye tareeqe se likhein
\[z^{2} - 2(3)z = -25\]
Kyun: \(+25\) ko doosri taraf le gaye to \(-25\) ban gaya. Aur \(-6z\) ko \(-2(3)z\) is liye likha taa ke yeh pattern \(z^{2} - 2hz + h^{2} = (z - h)^{2}\) se mil jaye, jahan \(h = 3\). Ab saaf nazar aa raha hai ke kami kis cheez ki hai: \(h^{2} = 3^{2}\).

Step 3: Dono sides par \(3^{2}\) jorein
\[z^{2} - 2(3)z + 3^{2} = -25 + 3^{2}\]
\[(z - 3)^{2} = -16\]
Kyun: equation ek tarazu (balance) ki tarah hai: jo cheez ek palre mein dalein, wohi doosre mein bhi dalni parti hai, tab hi barabari qaim rehti hai. Left side ab perfect square \((z - 3)^{2}\) ban gayi, aur right side \(-25 + 9 = -16\).
Dhyan dein: bohat se students \(9\) sirf left side par jorte hain. Yeh ghalat hai, is se equation hi badal jati hai.

Step 4: Square root lein
\[z - 3 = \pm\sqrt{-16}\]
\[\sqrt{-16} = \sqrt{16}\sqrt{-1} = 4i\]
\[z = 3 \pm 4i\]
Kyun: right side negative hai, aur real numbers mein kisi ka square negative nahin hota. Lekin complex numbers mein \(\sqrt{-1} = i\) hai, is liye \(\sqrt{-16} = 4i\). \(\pm\) zaroori hai kyun ke \(4i\) aur \(-4i\) dono ka square \(-16\) hai: \((4i)^{2} = 16i^{2} = -16\) aur \((-4i)^{2} = -16\). Aakhir mein dono sides mein 3 jora to \(z\) akela reh gaya.

Step 5: Roots likhein
\(z = 3 + 4i\) ya \(z = 3 - 4i\), yahi required complex roots hain.
Kyun: quadratic (degree 2) ke \(C\) mein bilkul do roots hote hain (Fundamental theorem of algebra). Ghor karein ke dono roots ek doosre ke conjugate (sirf imaginary part ka sign ulta) hain. Real coefficients wali equation mein complex roots hamesha aise hi joron mein aate hain.

Step 6: Corollary se factors banayein
\[2z^{2} - 12z + 50 = 2(z^{2} - 6z + 25)\]
\[= 2(z - (3 + 4i))(z - (3 - 4i))\]
\[= 2(z - 3 - 4i)(z - 3 + 4i)\]
Kyun: corollary kehti hai \(P(z) = a(z - z_{1})(z - z_{2})\), jahan leading coefficient \(a = 2\) aur roots \(3 \pm 4i\) hain. Step 1 mein humne equation ko 2 se divide kiya tha, yeh equation ke liye theek tha (kyun ke right side 0 thi), lekin polynomial ke liye woh 2 wapas aage rakhna zaroori hai, warna factors ka product asal polynomial ka sirf aadha hoga.

Tasdeeq:
\[(z - 3 - 4i)(z - 3 + 4i) = (z - 3)^{2} - (4i)^{2}\]
\[= z^{2} - 6z + 9 + 16\]
\[= z^{2} - 6z + 25\]
Ise 2 se multiply karein to \(2z^{2} - 12z + 50\) wapas mil jata hai. Root bhi check karein: \(z = 3 + 4i\) rakhne se \(2(-7 + 24i) - 12(3 + 4i) + 50 = 0\), kyun ke \((3 + 4i)^{2} = 9 + 24i - 16 = -7 + 24i\). Dono checks sahi hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Practice ke liye ek aur (yeh kitab ka sawal nahin): \(z^{2} + 4z + 13 = 0\).
Constant ko right le jayein: \(z^{2} + 4z = -13\).
\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha \(2\), us ka square \(4\); dono taraf jorein: \((z + 2)^{2} = -9\).
Square root: \(z + 2 = \pm 3i\), yani \(z = -2 \pm 3i\).
Factors: \(z^{2} + 4z + 13 = (z + 2 - 3i)(z + 2 + 3i)\). Khud multiply kar ke tasdeeq kijiye!

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Completing the square har quadratic par chalta hai, un par bhi jin ke roots complex hon.
2. Pehle \(z^{2}\) ka coefficient 1 banayein, phir dono sides par (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) jorein.
3. Right side negative aaye to roots complex honge: \(h \pm i\sqrt{k}\). Real coefficients ho to yeh ek doosre ke conjugate hote hain.
4. Factorize karte waqt leading coefficient aage rakhein: \(P(z) = a(z - z_{1})(z - z_{2})\).
5. Aakhir mein factors multiply kar ke ya root rakh kar tasdeeq karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(h^{2}\) sirf left side par jorna; equation tarazu hai, dono palron mein barabar daliye.
2. Square root lete waqt \(\pm\) bhool jana; is se ek root gum ho jata hai.
3. \(\sqrt{-16} = -4\) likh dena: negative number ka square root imaginary hota hai, \(4i\).
4. \(2z^{2} - 12z + 50\) ke aakhri factors mein 2 chhor dena.
5. \(-(3 - 4i)\) kholte waqt sign ki ghalti: yeh \(-3 + 4i\) hai.
